businesses.business: connected cutting machines and craft consumables

offering_description.value: Designs and sells smart cutting machines, heat presses and other crafting tools to hobbyists and small crafters. Also sells materials and accessories, plus a design software app and paid subscription. Products are made by contract manufacturers and sold online and through retailers.

primary_products.value: electronic cutting machines; heat presses; craft materials such as vinyl and iron-on; blades, mats and accessories; pens and tools

primary_services.value: design software subscription; digital design content and fonts

customer_segment.value: B2C: hobbyist crafters, DIY makers, home decorators, small craft sellers

end_markets.value: arts and crafts; DIY home decor; personalized gifts and apparel

revenue_model.value: product sales: connected machines, accessories and materials sold to consumers and retailers; subscription: membership for design images, fonts and projects

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets machines and materials made by contract manufacturers, sold to consumers and retailers; software / platform: design app and subscription content platform for users

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, with the US as largest market

specialization.value: related lines: cutting machines, heat presses, craft materials and design subscription serving the same crafters

distribution_channels.value: online: company website selling direct to consumers; third-party retail: big-box and craft retailers and online marketplaces

regulatory_exposure.value: low: product safety, import tariffs and data privacy rules apply, otherwise ordinary business rules
